Instructions

To optimize your study time, we recommend you try doing each problem as if you are taking an exam and write out full solutions to each problem. You should not use a calculator or other website to solve the problem unless the question specifies you round the final answer, in that case find the exact value answer and then use a calculator to round the final value to the specified number of decimal places.

Before starting this assignment, review your notes for this Section.

Visit our APPM learning center if you have any questions. Find more information here. The homework hours schedule can be found on our canvas course home page. You are welcome and encouraged to work on WebAssign homework while attending homework hours so you can get any questions answered (and you will have questions, this is simply a part of the learning process!).

The preview assignment needed for the last problem or two in this assignment can be found in our canvas page at canvas.colorado.edu. Go to the homepage, click assignments, and then look for the WebAssign assignment. Find more information here.



Please note that WebAssign is case-sensitive.  If you get a problem wrong, make sure you are using not using upper-case letters for your variables when you should be using lower-case letters.



You may come across a word you are not familiar with. Go ahead and look it up in our textbook or a quick google search will help you find it's definition.

Assignment Submission

For this assignment, you submit answers by question parts. The number of submissions remaining for each question part only changes if you submit or change the answer.

Assignment Scoring

Your best submission for each question part is used for your score.
